name: Health
short_desc: View: your recovery, sleep and activity from connected wearables such as WHOOP, in plain sentences, every day as a square like a GitHub graph.
author: Humanity Labs
description: A health tracker over the wearables you connect (WHOOP, Oura, Fitbit, Polar, Withings, Garmin, Coros, Apple Health). Activity, Recovery and Sleep each get a card in one traffic-light colour with a big number and one plain sentence (tap it for the numbers behind it), above a GitHub-style graph of every day; tap a day to see it. Wide windows show all three side by side; on a phone a bottom bar switches between Activity and Recovery & sleep. Health reads connector apps through the health-data contract and never holds a wearable's keys. Your agent gets read-only tools for the same data.
